svg.aria-label: Cohort retention heatmap VISTARA 2024. Real data from vistara.v_cohort_retention.
svg.title: Cohort Retention Heatmap — VISTARA 2024
svg.desc: Monthly cohort retention — real data from vistara.v_cohort_retention. Jan-2024 cohort (n=4,382) retains ~57–63% through M6, then drops below 40%. Smaller cohorts show rapid drop to red (<20%) by M3-M5.
